metadata.llm_reason: Candidate 'Semantic Attribute Capture for API Calls' and peer 'Attribute Extraction from Method Calls' are semantically identical micro_skills at the same asset level performing the same core capability: extracting and normalizing telemetry attributes (model name, token counts, latency) from instrumented calls into OpenTelemetry-compliant metadata. Both operate at instrumentation stage with identical constraints (no sensitive data, graceful handling of missing attributes, schema compliance). The candidate uses 'agentops.semconv' while peer uses 'OpenTelemetry naming conventions'—these are the same standard. Merge candidate into peer to consolidate duplicate capability and avoid registry fragmentation.
